Author: Anomek
Name: AnoMech
Punchline: Another FFXIV mechanics simulator. Go to an inn and start practice.
Description: Fork of anomek/AnoMech with Dragonsong's Reprise (Ultimate) P5 Death of the Heavens and P6 Wroth Flames scenarios (LPDU strat). Spawns fake party members and bosses client-side so you can practice raid mechanics without a full party.
